dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Extremely prominent and sharp pale edges create high-contrast boundaries against the dark interior of the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low-distinctness transition with no linear boundary, characterized by a gradual shift from fine cephalic mottling to coarse dorsal scaling.

other_distinctive_markers: Exceptional high-contrast scalloped pattern across the entire dorsal surface produced by uniform pale fringing on dark feathers.
